posting_windows.sample: brief posts with a complete impressions snapshot
posting_windows.signals: reach (impressions, all measured briefs) and engagement rate (engagements / impressions, briefs with above-median reach only), each hour vs the rest of the day, Mann-Whitney + Cliff's delta, Holm-corrected across all hour x signal contrasts
posting_windows.instruction: When assigning posting_time, prefer recommended_hours and never use avoid_hours, but keep the day's usual shape: the same number of posts, spread across the day, at least 20 minutes apart, no more than 2 posts in any one hour, and within the caps of 5 posts 6AM-noon, 4 posts noon-6PM, 3 posts 6PM-midnight CT. Hours without a verdict are neutral. If recommended_hours is empty, keep the current schedule.
posting_windows.note: No hour cleared the Holm-corrected significance gates against the rest of the day; keep the current schedule.

methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.
